subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], Thank you for choosing our airline for your upcoming trip. We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on May 15th at 10:00 AM. Your seat assignment is 12A. Please make sure to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels! Best regards, The Airline Team
